title: How much do Europeans trust each other?
subtitle: Across the EU, in 2024 citizens rated their trust in others at an average of 5.8 out of 10. The range of scores was from less than 5 in Cyprus, France, Lithuania, Slovenia and Greece, to 7 or higher in Romania, Finland and Poland.
textNote: Trust in others can be defined as an abstract evaluation of a person's opinion or feeling regarding a core value or belief. The reference to others pertains to individuals with whom the respondent is not acquainted.
